title: Nano Payment Instrument
description: A payment instrument for Nano (XNO), a feeless, single-block-final settlement asset. The settlement block is itself the credential — no PCI-DSS surface, no PAN or network token, no dispute-window reconciliation. Per-checkout derived addresses bind a confirmed send to its checkout without a memo field.

constraint_target.title: Nano Address Constraint Target
constraint_target.description: The object an available Nano instrument's `constraints` describes. It declares the constrainable members and their types and is never carried in a payload.

receive_address.description: The handler-issued destination address for this checkout. The settlement block's `link` field must equal this address; because each checkout receives a unique derived address, the block hash is bound to exactly one checkout.

type.description: Indicates this is a Nano payment instrument.

receive_address.description: The handler-issued Nano destination address for this checkout. Derived deterministically per checkout (e.g., BIP32-style hardened derivation at a checkout-index path) so that a confirmed send block is provably bound to exactly one checkout. MUST be a valid Nano account address beginning with `nano_`.

settlement_block.description: The Nano send block hash that settles this payment. Present after the buyer has submitted the send. The block is self-verifying: its `link` field MUST match `receive_address`, and its amount MUST equal the agreed checkout total. Verification can be performed against any Nano node or indexed explorer.

display.description: Display information for this Nano payment instrument.

address_short.description: Shortened display form of the Nano address (prefix + first 6 chars + '...' + last 6 chars). Presentational only.

description.description: An optional rich text description of the Nano payment to display to the user (e.g., 'Nano (XNO) — feeless, instant settlement').
